title: Apple Rose Puff Pastries

ingredients.note: for the glaze, plus more to dust

steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (180°C).
Beat the butter, brown sugar and cinnamon until creamy.
Wash the apples and slice them as thin as you can.
Roll each puff pastry sheet a little thinner, spread with the cinnamon butter, and cut in half lengthwise.
Line apple slices along one long edge, overlapping and sticking out past the edge, then fold the bottom of the pastry up over them.
Roll each strip up into a rose and set in a muffin tin or on a lined sheet.
Brush with the lemon juice and powdered sugar mixed together, and bake until deep golden.
Dust with powdered sugar to serve.
notes: Translated from Turkish (Elmalı Gül Çörekler). Makes about 12 roses. Holiday recipe, kept as written. Nutrition is estimated per rose.

title: Dad's Creamy & Cheesy Au Gratin Potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F and spray a 9-inch square baking dish.
Arrange the potato slices in 3 or 4 loose, slightly slanted rows, tucking onion slices in between and on top.

Melt the butter in a pot over medium heat, whisk in the flour for about 30 seconds, then slowly whisk in the milk until smooth. Simmer until thick like gravy, about 5 minutes. Over low heat, stir in the cheddar, salt, garlic powder and pepper.
Pour the sauce over the potatoes, cover with foil, and bake 45 minutes.
Uncover, sprinkle with the Gruyère and parmesan, and bake 30 to 45 minutes more until tender and golden. Broil 1 to 2 minutes for a crispier top if you like.
Cool 10 minutes and top with chives. Make ahead: assemble, cover and refrigerate up to a day; add 10 to 15 minutes to the bake.
notes: From Ambitious Kitchen's Thanksgiving roundup (https://www.instagram.com/reel/Dfm__5aFLZM/). Holiday recipe, kept as written: the sauce uses wheat flour. A cup-for-cup gluten-free flour would work in its place.

title: Avocado Bread Rounds
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F and line a baking sheet with greased parchment.
Mix the avocado, egg and cottage cheese.
Scoop into 2 rounds, top with everything bagel seasoning, and bake 15 to 20 minutes.
notes: Makes 2 rounds. Nutrition is estimated. Check the everything bagel seasoning for a gluten-free label.

title: Banana Cinnamon Protein Smoothie
steps: Blend everything until smooth, adding ice to thicken.
notes: From Bree's recipe collection. Nutrition is estimated.

title: Beer Cheese Soup

ingredients.note: a little, for tossing the cheese

ingredients.item: Sour cream and soft pretzel buns

steps: Melt the butter in a Dutch oven over medium-high and cook the carrots and onion until soft and lightly browned, about 7 minutes. Add the garlic until fragrant.
Sprinkle in the flour and cook, stirring, 2 minutes.
Pour in the beer, bring to a boil, then simmer 20 minutes. Meanwhile cook the bacon, drain, and cut into 1/2-inch pieces.
Stir in the broth, Worcestershire, Dijon and salt, bring to a boil, then simmer 10 minutes.
Cool 5 minutes, then purée in batches in a blender (vent the lid and cover with a towel). Return to the pot.
Over medium heat, whisk in the milk and cook 10 minutes to thicken slightly.
Off the heat, toss the cheese with a little cornstarch and stir it in a handful at a time until smooth. Add the hot sauce and white pepper.
Top with bacon, chives and sour cream. Add chicken and bacon last if you're making it a meal. Don't boil after adding the cheese or it will separate.
notes: From Bree's recipe collection (her notes: add chicken and bacon last, and remember to purée). The original's 3/4 cup celery is swapped for extra carrot. Room-temperature cheese melts best; use real cheese, not processed.

title: Healthy Blueberry Mini Waffles
steps: Heat a mini waffle maker.
Whisk the eggs, yogurt and vanilla until smooth. Stir in the almond flour and baking powder until just combined.
Fold in the blueberries (add frozen ones straight from the freezer).
Spoon batter into the waffle maker without overfilling and cook until golden and set.
Serve warm with a spoonful of Greek yogurt and extra berries.
notes: Instagram post: https://www.instagram.com/reel/Df7lOSupb9D/. Maple syrup dropped from the batter and topping; blueberries do the sweetening. Site lists 148 cal and 6 g protein per waffle; this is 2 waffles per serving. Not very high in protein; add a cup of Greek yogurt on the side.

title: Blueberry Pancake Casserole

ingredients.note: melted, plus more for the griddle

steps: Whisk the flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt and 2 tsp sugar. Separately whisk the buttermilk and 2 eggs, stir into the flour, then stir in the melted butter. Rest 5 minutes.
Cook 1/4-cup pancakes on a buttered griddle over medium-high, 3 to 4 minutes per side, to make about 20.
Halve the pancakes and stand them cut side down in 2 rows in a greased 11x7-inch dish.
Whisk the cream, milk, 6 eggs, vanilla, cinnamon and 1/4 cup sugar, and pour over the pancakes. Cover and refrigerate at least 8 hours.
Heat the oven to 350°F. Top with blueberries and bake uncovered 50 to 55 minutes, until set. Rest 5 minutes.
Warm the maple syrup with the butter, drizzle 1/4 cup over the top, and serve the rest on the side.
notes: From Bree's recipe collection. Assemble the night before; the pancakes can be made a day ahead too.

title: Blueberry Vanilla Protein Smoothie

ingredients.note: Bree recommends Dymatize ISO-100 Gourmet Vanilla

steps: Blend everything until smooth.
notes: From Bree's recipe collection. The original has an optional teaspoon of honey and vanilla yogurt; plain yogurt keeps it free of added sugar. Nutrition is estimated.

title: Baked Brie with Leeks & Almonds

ingredients.note: white and light green parts, sliced into thin rounds and washed

steps: Heat the oven to 375°F.
Melt the butter in an oven-safe skillet over medium heat and cook the leeks, stirring, until soft and silky, 5 to 7 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
Slice the top rind off the brie and nestle the wheel, cut side up, in the middle of the leeks. Spoon some leeks over and around it.
Scatter the sliced almonds over the top.
Bake about 10 minutes, until the brie is melting and the almonds are toasted.
Serve hot in the skillet with endive leaves for scooping.
notes: The creator never wrote this one down; this version is worked out from her video (leeks, brie and sliced almonds, served with endive). Amounts, oven temperature and time are estimates, so check it as it bakes. Her caption says it takes about 10 minutes. Nutrition is estimated.

title: Crispy Parmesan Broccoli Chips

ingredients.item: Salt, garlic powder and onion powder

steps: Heat the oven to 420°F and line a large rimmed baking sheet with parchment.
Blanch the florets in salted boiling water for 1 to 2 minutes, drain, and pat dry.
Sprinkle the parmesan in a thin layer on the sheet, set the broccoli on top with space between, and press each piece flat with the bottom of a small glass.
Season with salt, onion powder and garlic powder. Bake 25 to 30 minutes, until the cheese is golden and the broccoli is crisp. Cool slightly and break apart.
For the dip, stir together the yogurt, hot sauce, rice vinegar, chives and a pinch of garlic and onion powder.
notes: Instagram post: https://www.instagram.com/reel/DeftxPAvaWu/. The original dip uses mayo, buttermilk and sriracha; swapped in a Greek yogurt dip with plain hot sauce (no sugar, more protein). Site numbers are for the chips without the dip.

title: High-Protein Broccoli Feta Bean Soup
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F.
Put the broccoli, onion, garlic and feta in a baking dish. Drizzle with olive oil and season with oregano, chili flakes, salt and pepper. Roast 35 to 40 minutes.
Blend the roasted vegetables and feta with the cottage cheese, bone broth, spinach, lemon zest and juice, and beans until smooth. Add water if it's too thick.
Warm through and serve. Fresh dill and a little grated parmesan on top are good.
notes: Creator's numbers: 317 cal and 24 g protein per serving; carbs and fat not listed. Check the bone broth for a gluten-free label.

title: Upside-Down Carrot Cornbread with Hot Honey Butter

ingredients.note: 90 g melted, 70 g softened, plus more for the pan
plus 3 tbsp to drizzle and 40 g for the butter
1/4 tsp for the carrots, 1/2 tsp for the batter

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Grease and line the base of a 10-inch square pan or a round skillet.

Toss the small carrots with 2 tbsp olive oil, 2 tbsp hot honey, 1 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp cayenne and a few pinches of thyme. Lay them flat-side down in the pan and bake 40 minutes until soft and caramelized.
Stir the lemon juice into the milk and set aside (it will curdle a little).
Whisk the flour, cornmeal, sugar, remaining 1 1/2 tsp salt and 1/2 tsp cayenne, garlic granules and baking powder.
Whisk the melted butter, 90 ml olive oil and eggs, then the milk. Whisk the wet into the dry until smooth, and fold in the grated carrots, cheddar, chillies and most of the remaining thyme.
Take out the carrots, lower the oven to 350°F (180°C), and drizzle 3 tbsp hot honey over them. Pour the batter on top and level it.
Bake 45 to 50 minutes until golden and a skewer comes out clean.
Mix the softened butter with 40 g hot honey and a pinch of flaky salt.
Turn the cornbread out onto a board, scatter with thyme, and serve warm with the hot honey butter.
notes: Instagram post: https://www.instagram.com/reel/Dfz8yychxzK/. Ocado lists no nutrition; this is an estimate including the honey butter. Holiday recipe, kept as written (wheat flour, sugar, honey).

title: Fiber & Immunity Protein Soup
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Spread the carrots, onion and garlic on a lined sheet pan.
Drizzle with olive oil, season with curry powder, smoked paprika, a generous pinch of salt and pepper, and roast 45 to 50 minutes.
Blend the roasted vegetables with the bone broth, cottage cheese, ginger, lemon juice, chickpeas and a pinch of chili flakes until creamy.
Taste and adjust with salt, curry powder, lemon or more broth. Top with parmesan, herbs and a squeeze of lemon.
notes: Creator's numbers per serving: 274 cal, 22 g protein, 9 g fiber; carbs and fat not listed. Check the bone broth and curry powder for gluten-free labels.

title: Cheeseburger Rice Paper Spring Rolls

ingredients.item: Paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper

steps: Heat the oven or air fryer to 400°F and line a baking sheet with parchment if baking.
Whisk the eggs in a shallow bowl. Dip a rice paper sheet for a few seconds and lay it on a lightly oiled surface.
Add beef across the lower third, season with salt, pepper, paprika and garlic powder, and top with mozzarella, onion and pickles.
Fold in the sides and roll up tightly. Brush with egg wash and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Repeat with the rest, then cook 15 to 20 minutes, flipping once if needed, until golden and crisp. Dip in mustard.
notes: From @thechefoutwest's rice paper collection. He serves them with a burger sauce, which usually has ketchup or relish (sugar); mustard keeps it sugar-free. Two rolls make a meal.

title: Crispy Cheese Egg & Avocado Quesadilla
steps: Warm a large nonstick skillet over medium-low heat for 1 to 2 minutes.
Sprinkle the cheese in a thin, even circle and let it start to melt.
Scatter the avocado, tomato and onion over the cheese.
Crack the eggs on top, keeping the yolks whole.
Cover and cook 4 to 6 minutes, until the whites are set and the cheese underneath is golden and crisp.
Loosen one side with a spatula, fold into a half-moon, slice and eat right away.
notes: No tortilla, so it's naturally gluten-free. The creator lists about 500 cal per serving, likely with full-fat cheese; an estimate with part-skim mozzarella is about 380.

title: Chili Crisp Egg Toast
steps: Fry the eggs in the chili crisp oil.
Toast the bread until crisp.
Top the toast with cottage cheese, avocado and the eggs.
notes: Honey dropped and sourdough swapped for gluten-free bread. Many chili crisps contain soy sauce (wheat) and a little sugar, so check the label, or fry the eggs in olive oil with a pinch of chili flakes instead. Nutrition is estimated with 2 eggs.

title: Creamy Chorizo Gnocchi
steps: Fry the chorizo in the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat, 2 to 3 minutes, until slightly crisp.
Add the shallot and cook 3 minutes until soft.
Meanwhile, cook the gnocchi in well-salted boiling water according to the package.
Stir the garlic and chili flakes into the pan for 1 minute, then add the wine and cook 1 minute. Stir in the tomato paste.
Scoop out 1/2 cup of the gnocchi water. Stir the cream cheese and that water into the pan until smooth and creamy, adding more water if it's thick.
Wilt in the spinach for 1 to 2 minutes, add the gnocchi, and toss.
Stir in the Parmesan, season, and serve with extra Parmesan.
notes: From Bree's recipe collection. The original's red bell pepper is left out. Most gnocchi contains wheat; gluten-free gnocchi is available.

title: Rosemary Cider Short Ribs with Sweet Potato Puree

ingredients.note: about 4, peeled and cut into 2-inch cubes
for the puree, more as needed

steps: Heat the oven to 325°F. Pat the ribs very dry and season all over with salt and pepper.
Brown the ribs in the oil in a 6-quart Dutch oven over medium heat, 3 to 5 minutes per side, in batches. Set aside.
Cook the onion and carrots, stirring, until the onion starts to caramelize, 10 to 12 minutes. Add the garlic for 1 to 2 minutes, then stir in the tapioca flour.

Stir in the broth, vinegar, coconut aminos and maple syrup, season with salt, and return the ribs. Lay the herbs on top, cover, and bake about 2 1/2 hours until falling off the bone. Uncover and cook 30 minutes more.
For the puree, simmer the sweet potatoes in salted water until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain and blend with the milk, butter, maple syrup and 1 tsp salt until completely smooth.
Discard the herb sprigs and bones. Serve each rib with sauce and vegetables over a scoop of puree.
notes: Instagram post: https://www.instagram.com/reel/DgAjnT3Ng9n/. The original has 3 celery ribs; swapped in 2 more carrots. Otherwise kept as written for the holiday (maple syrup in the braise and puree). Already gluten-free. Nutrition is estimated; the site lists none.

title: Apple Cider Mimosa with Cinnamon-Sugar Rim
steps: Dip the rim of a flute in maple syrup, let the excess drip off, then dip it in cinnamon sugar.
Pour in the cider, then top with sparkling wine.
Garnish with a rosemary or thyme sprig.
notes: Ratio from Budget Bytes; the maple-dip cinnamon-sugar rim is Feast & West's (https://feastandwest.com/apple-cider-mimosa/). Feast & West also suggests splitting the cider with 1 oz cranberry and 1 oz pomegranate juice. Nutrition is estimated.

title: Crispy Cottage Cheese Chips
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F and line a baking sheet with parchment.
Wrap the cottage cheese in a kitchen towel and squeeze out as much liquid as you can. Don't skip this.
Mix everything except the paprika. It will look dry; add a little more drained cottage cheese if it won't hold together.
Press into very flat chips about 2 inches apart (they spread) and sprinkle with smoked paprika.
Bake 20 minutes until the edges are golden, then lower the oven to 250°F and bake 15 to 20 minutes more. Very brown edges are fine.
Let them cool completely on the pan; they crisp as they cool.
notes: Makes 10 to 15 chips; a serving is 2 to 3. Nutrition is estimated.

title: Cottage Cheese Breakfast Wrap

ingredients.item: Greek yogurt mixed with plain hot sauce

steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (180°C) and line a tray with parchment. Spread the cottage cheese about 1/2 inch thick and sprinkle with the bagel seasoning.
Bake 20 minutes, blot off any water with a paper towel, push it back into shape if needed, and bake 20 more until set and crisp.
Meanwhile, cook the bacon until crisp and fry the egg.
Peel the wrap off the parchment and spread avocado over one half. Add the tomato, bacon, egg, salt and pepper, the hot-sauce yogurt and green onion.
Fold and eat.
notes: Instagram post: https://www.instagram.com/reel/Df48IUzgusT/. This is Victoria's free wrap recipe; the original reel may be a variation where the egg is baked into the wrap. Sriracha mayo swapped for Greek yogurt with plain hot sauce (no sugar). Check the seasoning label for gluten-free. Nutrition is estimated.

title: Cranberry Pecan Cheese Log
steps: Mix the pecans, cranberries and chives in a small bowl.
In a large bowl, combine the cream cheese and cheddar, then mix in half the pecan mixture (save the rest for the outside).
Shape into a log on a large sheet of plastic wrap, using the wrap to hold it tight. Refrigerate at least an hour to firm up.
To serve, spread the rest of the pecan mixture on a board, unwrap the log, and roll it to coat all over.
Serve with crackers (gluten-free ones keep it gluten-free).
notes: Instagram post: https://www.instagram.com/reel/Df1mpNao6ll/. Holiday recipe, kept as written; dried cranberries are sweetened.

title: Cranberry Orange Mimosa

ingredients.item: Fresh cranberries and a rosemary sprig

steps: Wet the rim of a flute and dip it in sanding sugar, if using.
Pour in the orange and cranberry juice.
Top with sparkling wine.
Garnish with cranberries and a rosemary sprig.
notes: Matches the orange-cranberry-rosemary ice cubes. Juice amounts are a starting ratio; see the source for hers. Nutrition is estimated.

title: Creamed Pearl Onions
steps: Combine the frozen onions, broth, sherry, bay leaf and thyme in a small saucepan over low heat. Simmer 5 to 6 minutes, stirring, until the onions thaw.
Whisk the cream and flour together and stir into the onions until smooth.
Simmer on low 3 to 4 minutes until thickened.
Off the heat, stir in the salt and pepper and remove the bay leaf.
notes: Closest match for @cocolarkincooks's creamed onions (https://www.instagram.com/reel/DfXreoBPEg1/); hers is paid-only on Substack and in her cookbook. Like hers, it uses frozen pearl onions. The site lists 509 cal per serving, which looks like the whole batch; the per-serving estimate is about 85. Cornstarch instead of flour makes it gluten-free.

title: Croissant Breakfast Casserole
steps: Chop the ham. Cook it in 1 tbsp oil over medium about 4 minutes to render the fat, then move it to a large bowl.
Add the remaining oil and the onions to the skillet and cook, stirring now and then, until deeply browned, about 30 minutes. Wilt in the spinach, add to the ham, and cool 10 minutes.
Whisk the eggs, milk, mustard, salt and pepper, and stir into the ham mixture with 1 cup of the cheese.
Arrange the croissants, slightly overlapping, in 2 rows in a greased 11x7-inch dish. Pour the mixture over and top with the remaining cheese.
Cover and refrigerate at least 8 hours or overnight.
Heat the oven to 375°F. Bake uncovered on a rimmed sheet about 1 hour, until golden and set; cover with foil after 25 minutes if it's browning too fast.
notes: From Bree's recipe collection. Assemble the night before and bake in the morning.

title: Sweet Potato Breakfast Egg Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F. Season the mashed sweet potato and spread it in a baking dish.
Brown the sausage, then add the spinach and cook until wilted.
Blend the eggs, cottage cheese, egg whites and seasonings until smooth.
Pour the eggs over the sweet potato, then scatter the sausage and spinach on top.
Sprinkle with the cheese and bake 35 to 40 minutes, until the center reaches 160°F.
Rest 10 minutes, top with chives, and cut into 6 portions.
notes: Red bell pepper left out (add extra spinach if you want more veg). Pick a chicken sausage labeled gluten-free with no added sugar; apple and maple varieties have sugar.

title: Mimosa Juice Cubes (Orange-Raspberry & Pineapple-Pomegranate)

ingredients.note: thin half-moons, optional, for the orange cubes

steps: Tuesday, round one: in 2-inch silicone cube molds, place 2 raspberries and a mint leaf (plus an orange half-moon if using) in each orange cube, and pomegranate seeds and a mint leaf in each pineapple cube.
Add just enough of the matching juice to cover the fruit, about 1/2 inch. Freeze 1 to 2 hours so the garnish locks onto that face.
Round two: fill the molds the rest of the way with juice and freeze overnight.
Thursday morning: pop the cubes out, flip them garnish side up, and keep them in a bowl in the freezer until serving.
Drop one cube in each glass, add a splash of the matching juice, and top with bubbly. As the cube melts it adds juice, not water.
notes: Juice freezes opaque, so the garnish has to go in first to show on the face of the cube. Most 2-inch trays make 6 cubes: use 3 trays, or start Monday and freeze in two batches. Plan on about 2 cubes per adult.

title: French Onion Green Bean Casserole
steps: Caramelize the onions: melt 1 tbsp butter in a wide pan over medium heat, cook the onions 5 minutes, then stir in 1 tsp salt and 1/2 tsp pepper and cook on very low, stirring now and then, until deep golden, 90 to 120 minutes. Add water a tablespoon at a time if they stick.
Heat the oven to 375°F and grease an 8x10-inch casserole dish.
Boil the green beans about 3 minutes until crisp-tender, chill in ice water, drain, and pat dry.
Melt 2 tbsp butter in a wide pan over medium heat and brown the mushrooms, about 10 minutes. Stir in the flour for 1 to 2 minutes.
Slowly add the milk, stirring, then cook over medium-high until thick and creamy, about 8 minutes. Season with the remaining salt and pepper and the nutmeg.
Layer half the beans, sauce, onions and Gruyère, then the rest of the beans, sauce and onions.
Melt the last 2 tbsp butter, toss with the croutons and parmesan, sprinkle on top, and finish with the rest of the Gruyère.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes until bubbly and lightly browned. Rest 10 minutes.
notes: Instagram post: https://www.instagram.com/reel/DfsVtm9SLPr/. Holiday recipe, kept as written: flour and croutons have wheat. The onions can be caramelized a day ahead.

title: French Onion Chuck Roast
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F. Season the roast with salt and pepper.
Melt the butter in an oven-safe pot and cook the onions low and slow until deep golden, 20 to 25 minutes. Add the garlic for the last minute.
Stir in the tomato paste, balsamic vinegar, tamari, thyme and broth.
Nestle the roast into the onions, cover, and bake 3 to 3 1/2 hours until it shreds easily.
Shred with two forks and stir so the onions and broth coat the meat. Taste for salt. Bake uncovered at 400°F for 30 minutes.
Top with the cheese and broil about 2 minutes until bubbly. Finish with parsley.
notes: Balsamic glaze swapped for plain balsamic vinegar and Worcestershire for tamari (both have added sugar). The creator serves it over a baked potato with Greek yogurt. Check the broth for a gluten-free label. Nutrition is estimated with cheese; a leaner roast or less cheese lowers the fat.

title: Cheesy Caramelized Onion Mashed Potato Bake

ingredients.note: 1 tbsp for the water, 1 tsp for the mash

steps: Cook the onions in 4 tbsp butter over medium heat about 10 minutes, then over medium-low 40 to 50 minutes more, stirring now and then, until deeply caramelized.
Peel and quarter the potatoes and boil in salted water 20 to 30 minutes until tender. Drain.
Heat the oven to 375°F.
In the same pot, melt the remaining butter with the cream and 1 tsp salt. Off the heat, add the potatoes, onions, onion dip and half the cheese, and mash. Spread in a 9x13-inch dish.
Pulse the bread into crumbs, toss with the parmesan, olive oil and a pinch of salt, and toast on a sheet 10 minutes.
Top the potatoes with the rest of the cheese and the crumbs. Bake covered 30 minutes, then uncovered 10 to 15 minutes until golden. Make ahead: refrigerate the mash up to 2 days, then top and bake.
notes: Closest match for The Culinary Cartel's French onion mashed potatoes (https://www.instagram.com/reel/DfUhe0hNjsQ/); theirs is free on Substack once you sign in. This one adds onion dip and a breadcrumb top. For pockets of melty cheese like the original, fold in cubed Gruyère instead of mashing it in. Skip the crumbs to make it gluten-free.

title: French Onion Chicken & Orzo Dump and Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Oil a baking dish (at least 9x9) and mix in the onions, garlic, olive oil and salt.
Cover with foil and bake 50 to 70 minutes, stirring once or twice, until the onions shrink by about half and turn golden.
Lower the oven to 375°F and set the garlic aside to cool.

Add the orzo, broth, cream, chicken and thyme to the hot dish, season, and squeeze in the roasted garlic. Stir, cover tightly, and bake 35 to 40 minutes until the orzo is tender and the chicken reaches 165°F.
Uncover, top with Gruyère, and broil 2 to 4 minutes until melted and browning. Rest 10 minutes and squeeze lemon over if you like.
notes: Instagram post: https://www.instagram.com/reel/DfxlQ07Kc_A/. Orzo is wheat pasta, so this isn't gluten-free as written; gluten-free orzo (made from rice or corn) is sold in most stores, though liquid and timing may need adjusting.

title: Creamy Garlic Confit Eggs
steps: Warm the cream, chili oil and garlic in a small pan over medium-low heat.
Add the tomatoes and crack in the eggs. Season with salt and pepper and sprinkle with parsley.
Cover and cook on medium-low until the whites are set and the yolks are how you like them. Lift the lid on and off for jammy yolks.
Finish with more parsley and chili oil if you like. Serve with gluten-free toast and avocado.
notes: Recipe by @arte_mon_amour. Served with gluten-free toast instead of sourdough. The creator didn't give amounts for the cream or tomatoes, so those are estimates. Rich: half-and-half instead of cream and 1 tbsp chili oil trims it. Nutrition is estimated, without toast or avocado.

title: Goat Cheese Mashed Potatoes
steps: Cover the potatoes with cold water by 1 inch, bring to a boil, then cook over medium until tender, about 15 minutes.
Drain and return to the pot. Add the goat cheese, cream, butter, salt and pepper, and mash.
Top with chives.
notes: From Bree's recipe collection. Serves 8 to 10.

title: Protein Green Bean Casserole

ingredients.item: Garlic powder, onion powder, paprika and black pepper
Everything bagel seasoning and fresh chives

steps: Heat the oven to 350°F.
Stir the cottage cheese, Greek yogurt, tamari, bouillon and seasonings together in a bowl.
Fold in the green beans, onion, garlic, water chestnuts and 1/2 cup of the mozzarella.
Spread in a baking dish and top with the remaining mozzarella, the parmesan and a sprinkle of everything bagel seasoning.
Bake about 30 minutes, until bubbly. Top with chives.
notes: Worcestershire swapped for gluten-free tamari (Worcestershire has sugar and molasses). The creator listed ingredients and bake time only; the mixing steps and water chestnut amount are mine. Check the bouillon and everything bagel seasoning for gluten-free labels. Creator lists 4 g fiber per serving.

title: Roasted Carrots with Honey Herb Butter
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Toss the carrots with the olive oil, thyme, salt and pepper, and spread on 2 rimmed baking sheets (keep the bowl).
Roast about 30 minutes, switching the pans halfway, until browned and tender.
Meanwhile, melt the butter in a small skillet over medium heat. Whisk in the honey, vinegar and a pinch of salt, and boil 1 to 2 minutes until slightly thickened.
Off the heat, whisk in the mustard, then the parsley and chives, saving a tablespoon of each for garnish.
Toss the carrots in the reserved bowl with the honey-herb butter and sprinkle with the saved herbs.
notes: From Bree's Thanksgiving plan, with her note: double this recipe!

title: Hoppin' John
steps: Put the onion soup in a large saucepan.
Add the can of water, salt and Tabasco and bring to a boil.
Add the black-eyed peas, cover, and simmer 45 minutes to 1 hour, until the peas are tender.
Sauté the ham in the oil.
Add 1 1/2 cups water, the rice and the ham to the peas.
Simmer about 5 minutes more, until the rice is tender and the water is absorbed.
notes: Family recipe card from January 1987, from Bree's recipe collection. Condensed onion soup usually contains wheat; a gluten-free version would need a gluten-free soup.

title: Brown Butter Hot Honey Corn Pudding
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F and grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Brown the butter in a small pot over medium-low heat, swirling, until nutty and golden. Let it cool a few minutes.
Whisk the sour cream, eggs, 2 tbsp hot honey and salt in a large bowl.
Fold in the drained sweet corn and the creamed corn, then stir in the cornbread mix and browned butter until just combined.
Pour into the dish and bake 45 to 55 minutes, until golden and just set in the center.
Drizzle with the remaining 2 tbsp hot honey and sprinkle with flaky salt.
notes: Ingredients are @cookwithauds's, from her caption; her steps are only in her video. The method follows Couple in the Kitchen's very similar brown butter corn pudding (https://coupleinthekitchen.com/southern-corn-pudding-recipe-with-brown-butter/), sized up for her larger cans. Splitting the hot honey between batter and topping is a guess. Holiday recipe, kept as written. Nutrition is estimated.

title: Smashed Japanese-Style Potato Salad
steps: Pierce the potatoes, wrap in damp paper towels, and microwave 4 to 6 minutes (longer as needed) until fork-tender. Peel when cool enough.
Boil the eggs 6 minutes, chill in ice water 5 to 10 minutes, and peel.
Salt the cucumber, wait 5 minutes, and squeeze out the water. Cook the bacon until crisp.
Whisk the yogurt, mayo, mustard, milk and pepper. Add the potatoes and 3 eggs and smash them into the dressing, leaving some chunks.
Fold in the cucumber and bacon. Top with the halved fourth egg and black pepper.
notes: Via @cook_18_. Bacon count is an estimate (the creator said 'bacon, chopped'). Nutrition is estimated.

title: Cran-Lime Sparkle (Kid-Friendly)
steps: Stir the cranberry juice and limeade together over ice.
Top with soda water.
Drop in a few cranberries so it looks like the grown-up glasses.
notes: A fancy glass for the kids. Sparkling cider works as a swap for the soda water. Nutrition is estimated.

title: Leek & Burrata Risotto

ingredients.note: divided: 1 halved lengthwise for searing, 2 thinly sliced

ingredients.item: Fine sea salt and black pepper

steps: Sear the halved leek, cut side down, in the neutral oil over medium-high heat until charred and tender, 6 to 8 minutes. Season and set aside.
In a wide pot, warm the olive oil over medium heat and cook the shallot and sliced leeks until soft, 5 to 6 minutes.
Add the rice and toast 1 to 2 minutes. Pour in the wine and stir until absorbed.
Add the warm broth a ladle at a time, stirring and letting each addition absorb, until the rice is creamy and al dente, 18 to 22 minutes.
Off the heat, stir in the butter, Parmigiano, lemon zest and thyme, plus the basil if using. Season to taste.
Spoon into bowls and top with the seared leeks, torn burrata, parsley, a drizzle of olive oil and black pepper.
notes: Ingredients and amounts are Yarin Danieli's, from her caption. Her method is subscriber-only on breadbakebeyond.com, so the steps are a standard risotto method. How she divides the leeks is a guess. Rich, so it's filed under Comfort. Check the broth for a gluten-free label. Nutrition is estimated.

title: Braised Leeks au Poivre

ingredients.note: white and light green parts, cut into 1-inch rounds

steps: Heat the oven to 350°F and butter a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Wash the leeks well, slice into 1- to 1 1/4-inch rounds, pat completely dry, and season with salt.
Sear the leeks in the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat, 4 to 5 minutes, flip, and sear 3 more, in batches. Arrange in a single layer in the dish.
Lightly crush the peppercorns. In the same pan over medium heat, cook the butter, shallot and pepper 1 to 2 minutes.
Off the heat, add the cognac, then cook it down. Add the stock and simmer until reduced by half.
Lower the heat, stir in the cream, thyme, Dijon, Worcestershire and salt, and simmer 2 to 3 minutes until it coats a spoon.
Pour over the leeks, cover with foil, and bake 25 to 35 minutes until the darker rounds are tender.
Toss the panko with both cheeses, sprinkle over, and broil about 4 minutes until golden. Top with chives.
notes: Instagram post: https://www.instagram.com/reel/Df4uv0BgkoB/. Holiday recipe, kept as written: panko has wheat. Gluten-free panko swaps in easily.

title: Braised Leeks & Chuck Roast
steps: Heat the oven to 325°F. Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and pepper.
Heat the neutral oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high heat and brown the beef on all sides in batches. Set aside.
Lower the heat, add the shallots and garlic, and cook 2 minutes. Pour in the wine and scrape up the browned bits.
Return the beef with the peppercorns, bay leaves and turmeric, and add water to come about two-thirds up the meat. Bring to a simmer, cover, and braise in the oven about 3 hours, until fork-tender.

Ladle out 1 1/2 to 2 cups of the braising liquid. Sear the leek pieces in the olive oil in a skillet until lightly golden, season with salt, pepper and thyme, add the reserved liquid, cover, and simmer 20 to 25 minutes until meltingly soft.
Serve the beef with the leeks and their liquid, topped with parsley, thyme and a drizzle of olive oil.
notes: Ingredients and amounts are Yarin Danieli's, from her caption (she cuts the leeks into 1 1/2- to 2-inch pieces). Her method is subscriber-only on breadbakebeyond.com, so the steps are a standard braise, timed to her listed 3 hr 35 min cook. She serves it with crusty bread; use gluten-free bread to keep it gluten-free. Nutrition is estimated.

title: Chicken Salad Lettuce Cups
steps: Mash the avocado with the Greek yogurt in a bowl.
Stir in the chopped eggs, chicken and onion. Season with salt and pepper.
Spoon into romaine leaves and top with hot sauce.
notes: Nutrition is estimated; the creator didn't list it. Check the hot sauce label for gluten-free and no sugar.

title: Loaf Pan Marinated Chicken Thighs
steps: Mix the yogurt, lemon juice, olive oil, spices, onion, cilantro, salt and pepper in a large bowl. Add the chicken and toss until every piece is coated.
Cover and refrigerate at least 30 minutes; 2 hours or overnight is better.
Heat the oven to 350°F convection (375°F regular). Line a loaf pan with parchment and pack the chicken in tightly, pressing out any gaps.
Cover loosely with foil and bake 40 minutes. Uncover and bake 15 more, until golden and cooked through with clear juices.
Rest 10 minutes in the pan, lift out by the parchment, slice, and spoon the pan juices over. Great in salads, bowls or lettuce wraps.
notes: Original recipe by @wholesomebysarah. Serves 4 to 6. Nutrition is estimated; the creator didn't list it.

title: Mashed Potato Casserole

ingredients.note: melted, plus more for the dish
lightly crushed: 1/2 cup in, 1 cup on top

steps: Heat the oven to 375°F and butter a 9x13-inch dish.
Stir the sour cream and onion soup mix together and refrigerate while you make the potatoes.
Cover the potatoes with cold water by 1 inch, bring to a boil, and cook until fork-tender, 20 to 25 minutes.
Drain, return to the pot, and mash until smooth. Stir in the onion dip, melted butter, cream, bacon, Monterey Jack, 1/2 cup fried onions and the salt. Season with pepper and spread in the dish.
Mix the remaining 1 cup fried onions with the chips and parmesan and sprinkle over the top.
Bake 15 to 20 minutes, until bubbling and browned. Top with chives.
notes: From Bree's Thanksgiving plan. Onion soup mix and fried onions usually contain wheat.

title: Holiday Mimosa Bar
sourceName: Setup from several mimosa bar guides

ingredients.note: about 1 bottle per 4 people, well chilled
orange, cranberry, apple cider, pomegranate, pear
fresh or sugared cranberries, pomegranate seeds, rosemary sprigs, orange slices, cinnamon sticks
plain sugar and cinnamon sugar, with a small dish of maple or honey for dipping
see the Festive Ice Cubes recipe

steps: Chill the bubbly and juices overnight.
Pour each juice into its own carafe or pitcher and label them.
Set out the garnishes and rim sugars in small bowls, with the ice cubes in a bucket.
Let everyone build their own: rim the glass, add 2 to 3 oz juice, top with bubbly, and garnish.
Keep the sparkling cider next to the bubbly so the non-drinkers (and the kid) can join in.
notes: Pulls together the mimosa recipes in this box. A little juice and mostly bubbly keeps each glass lighter on sugar.

title: Mustard Cheesy Leeks

ingredients.note: grated, plus 1 oz for the top
chopped, for the top (instead of breadcrumbs)

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F.
Simmer the leeks in salted water 3 minutes until just tender, then drain and cool under cold water. (For the original's charred look, sear them cut side down in a cast iron pan instead.)
Whisk the butter, flour and milk in a saucepan over medium heat until it boils, then simmer 2 minutes.
Stir in the cheddar, parmesan and both mustards, and season with salt, pepper and nutmeg.
Lay the leeks in a shallow baking dish (or the cast iron pan) and pour the sauce over.
Top with the extra cheddar and chopped hazelnuts and bake about 20 minutes until golden.
notes: Closest match for @the_fussyfoodie_'s mustard cheesy leeks (https://www.instagram.com/reel/Df_3zilxyk9/); hers is only in the Instagram comments. Swapped this recipe's breadcrumb topping for hazelnuts like hers. She uses three mustards; add 1 tsp English mustard to get closer. The sauce uses wheat flour.

title: Obi's Oven Brisket

ingredients.item: Salt Lick rub or your favorite rub

steps: Heat the oven to 300°F.
Coat the brisket all over with plenty of rub.
Put half the onions and garlic under the brisket and half on top.
Pour the broth and Worcestershire over it.
Cover with foil and bake 5 to 6 hours.
If there's too much liquid, uncover for the last 30 minutes.
notes: Obi's recipe. Gluten-free as long as the rub and Worcestershire are; Lea & Perrins in the US is labeled gluten-free. Nutrition is estimated for about 4 oz cooked.

title: Onion Ring Chips
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F and line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment (foil and wax paper stick).
Spread the parmesan in a thin, even layer.
Lay the onion rings on the cheese, close but not overlapping.
Brush lightly with olive oil and season with salt, garlic powder and paprika.
Bake about 18 minutes, until golden. Cool 5 to 10 minutes, then break apart.
notes: Original recipe by @hungry.happens. Creator's numbers for the whole tray were 940 cal and 77 g protein; these are per quarter.

title: Oven Roasted Ribs
steps: Heat the oven to 275°F. Pat the ribs dry and remove the membrane.
Cut each rack in half, rub the tops with mustard, and season with salt and pepper.
Seal each half in a foil packet and set bone side down on a baking sheet. Bake 2 1/2 hours.
Open the packets, fold the foil back, and brush the ribs generously with barbecue sauce. Don't rewrap.
Raise the oven to 400°F and bake 25 minutes more (190 to 205°F inside for fall-off-the-bone).
Broil 3 to 5 minutes, adding another coat of sauce if you like.
notes: From Bree's recipe collection. Most barbecue sauces have sugar and some have wheat; check the label if that matters.

title: Protein Overnight Oats Jar
steps: Stir the oats, yogurt, milk, chia and peanut butter together in a jar.
Top with berries, put the lid on, and refrigerate overnight.
Make 3 at once on Sunday for three mornings.
notes: Use oats labeled certified gluten-free; regular oats are often cross-contaminated with wheat.

title: PB Powder Banana Shake
steps: Blend everything until smooth. Drizzle a little peanut butter powder mixed with water on top if you like.
notes: From Bree's recipe collection. Nutrition is estimated.

title: Peach Vanilla Protein Smoothie

ingredients.note: Bree recommends Dymatize ISO-100 Gourmet Vanilla

steps: Blend everything until smooth.
notes: From Bree's recipe collection. The original uses sweetened vanilla almond milk, Greek Gods honey vanilla yogurt and an optional teaspoon of honey; unsweetened milk and plain yogurt keep it free of added sugar. Nutrition is estimated with plain nonfat yogurt.

title: Cinnamon Pear Mimosa
steps: Wet the rim of a flute and dip it in cinnamon sugar.
Pour in equal parts pear juice and sparkling wine.
No rim? Drop a cinnamon stick in the glass instead.
notes: Ties in with the pears in the brie and the salad. For a pitcher version, Hy-Vee simmers 4 cups pear juice with 3 cinnamon sticks and 1 tsp cardamom, then chills it (https://hy-vee.com/recipes-ideas/recipes/spiced-pear-mimosas). Nutrition is estimated.

title: Roasted Sweet Potato, Pear & Pomegranate Spinach Salad

ingredients.item: melted coconut oil or olive oil

ingredients.note: or coconut sugar or maple syrup

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Whisk the oil, brown sugar, garlic powder, cinnamon and cayenne, toss with the sweet potatoes on a baking sheet, and season with salt and pepper.
Roast 20 to 30 minutes, tossing halfway, until tender and a little crisp at the edges.
Toast the pecans in a dry pan over medium heat 3 to 6 minutes until fragrant, cool, and chop.
Shake the dressing ingredients together in a jar.
Toss the spinach, pomegranate, pears and sweet potatoes in a large bowl. Top with pecans and goat cheese and drizzle with dressing.
notes: From Ambitious Kitchen's Thanksgiving roundup (https://www.instagram.com/reel/Dfm__5aFLZM/). Holiday recipe, kept as written. To make it sugar-free, skip the brown sugar and maple syrup; the pears and pomegranate are sweet enough.

title: Pistachio Pear Fig & Goat Cheese Phyllo Rolls

ingredients.note: finely chopped, plus more to serve

steps: Heat the oven to 375°F and generously butter 1 or 2 muffin tins.
Stack the phyllo sheets. Along one long edge, spread the goat cheese in a 2-inch strip (wet hands help).
Layer on the fig preserves, pear slices and pistachios, then roll up tightly like a burrito.
Slice into 1- to 1 1/2-inch pieces and set each in a muffin cup.
Drizzle each generously with olive oil, about 2 tsp, for flaky, crunchy layers.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes, rotating halfway, until deep golden. Rest 10 minutes, then drizzle with honey and top with thyme and more pistachios.
notes: Full recipe also at abrightmoment.com. Holiday recipe, kept as written: phyllo has wheat, and the preserves and honey have sugar. Nutrition is estimated per piece.

title: Poinsettia Cocktail

ingredients.item: Fresh cranberries and a rosemary sprig or orange twist

steps: Pour the Cointreau and cranberry juice into a flute.
Top with champagne.
Garnish with cranberries and rosemary or an orange twist.
For a crowd: mix the cranberry juice and Cointreau in a pitcher and chill it, then top each glass with champagne as guests arrive.
notes: A grown-up cranberry mimosa with orange liqueur. The amounts match across A Couple Cooks, Flavor the Moments and Difford's Guide. Nutrition is estimated.

title: Pomegranate Mimosa

ingredients.item: Pomegranate seeds and a rosemary sprig

steps: Run a lime wedge around the rim of a flute and dip it in sugar.
Fill the glass about two-thirds with champagne.
Top up with pomegranate juice.
Drop in a few pomegranate seeds and a rosemary sprig.
notes: The seeds float and sparkle in the glass. Ounces are an estimate of 'two-thirds champagne, fill with juice.' Nutrition is estimated.

title: High-Protein Chocolate Cake
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F and line a small cake pan.
Whisk the yogurt and eggs until smooth, then whisk in the cocoa, baking powder and salt.
Pour into the pan and bake about 25 minutes, until just set. Cool completely.
For the frosting, blend the cottage cheese and cocoa until smooth, then spread over the cake.
notes: Maple syrup dropped. Without any sweetener it's dark and fairly bitter; half a mashed ripe banana in the batter adds sweetness with no added sugar. The creator offers stevia or monk fruit for the frosting if you're fine with those. Skipped her second frosting (whey protein powder). Nutrition is estimated, with frosting.

title: Pumpkin Cheesecake Bars with Gingersnap Crust

ingredients.note: whipped, for topping (or a can of whipped cream)

steps: Wednesday: set the cream cheese and eggs out to soften. Heat the oven to 350°F. Line a 9x13 pan with foil or parchment, leaving extra hanging over two sides, and grease it lightly.
Crush the gingersnaps into fine crumbs with the sugar and cinnamon (food processor, or a zip bag and a rolling pin). Stir in the melted butter until every crumb is moistened.
Press the crumbs firmly into the bottom of the pan. Bake 10 to 12 minutes.
While the crust bakes, beat the eggs and sugar until light and foamy. Add the cream cheese, pumpkin, pumpkin pie spice and vanilla and beat until smooth. Pour over the baked crust and smooth the top.
Bake 30 to 40 minutes, until the edges are set and the center barely jiggles. Cool on a rack about 30 minutes, then cover and refrigerate overnight (at least 3 hours).

Thursday: lift the slab out by the overhang and cut into 24 squares with a sharp knife, wiping the blade between cuts. Top each with whipped cream, chopped pecans, a drizzle of caramel if using, and a pinch of spice.
notes: Doubled from the original 8x8 recipe (12 bars) to fit a 9x13 (24 bars); the doubled batch is a bit thicker, so it may need the longer bake. Nutrition is the site's per-bar figure, before toppings. Bake Wednesday so the pan is free and the bars are fully chilled.

title: Crispy Parmesan Ranch Potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Score the cut side of each potato half with diagonal lines.
Toss the potatoes with the avocado oil and 1 tsp of the ranch seasoning.
In a 9x11-inch baking dish, mix the parmesan, remaining ranch seasoning and melted butter into a thick paste and spread it across the bottom.
Press the potatoes cut-side down firmly into the cheese.
Bake 25 to 26 minutes, then rest 10 minutes so the parmesan crust hardens.
Garnish with chives and flaky salt, break apart and serve. Make ahead: assemble in the dish, cover, refrigerate, and bake when ready.
notes: Kalejunkie's 'Everything But The Turkey' series. Check the ranch seasoning label for gluten-free. Nutrition is estimated.

title: Raspberry Lemon Loaf Cake

ingredients.note: fresh or frozen (keep frozen until folding in)

steps: Heat the oven to 350°F and grease a 9x5-inch loaf pan.
Whisk the flour, baking powder and salt.
Beat the sugar and butter 3 to 4 minutes until fluffy. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then the lemon zest and juice.
Fold in the dry ingredients, then the yogurt, then gently fold in the raspberries.
Bake 60 to 70 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool at least 30 minutes.
Whisk the powdered sugar, lemon juice and zest, and drizzle over the completely cooled cake. Store in the fridge to keep it longer.
notes: From Bree's recipe collection (the original is a PDF from Confessions of a Baking Queen).

title: Bacon, Egg & Cheese Rice Paper Bagels

ingredients.note: 4 for the filling, 2 for the egg wash

steps: Heat the oven or air fryer to 400°F (convection if you have it).
Scramble 4 of the eggs over medium-low until just set but still soft. Set aside.
Whisk the other 2 eggs in a shallow plate. Dip each rice paper sheet until coated and pliable and lay it on a lightly oiled surface.
Divide the scrambled eggs, bacon and cheese across the sheets.
Roll each into a tight log, then tuck one end into the other to make a bagel shape.
Set on parchment, brush with leftover egg wash, and sprinkle generously with everything bagel seasoning.
Bake or air fry 12 to 15 minutes until golden and crisp.
notes: From @thechefoutwest's rice paper collection (https://www.instagram.com/reel/DfpnvXAmbJX/). Most bacon is cured with a little sugar; look for sugar-free bacon if you want to be strict. Check rice paper and everything bagel seasoning labels for gluten-free.

title: Bacon Egg & Cheese Rice Paper Spiral

ingredients.note: 4 for the filling, 1 for the egg wash

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet with parchment.
Scramble 4 eggs over medium-low until just set but still soft.
Whisk the last egg in a shallow bowl and dip each rice paper sheet in it, coating both sides.
Overlap the sheets on a lightly oiled surface to make one large sheet.
Add the scrambled eggs down the center, then the bacon and mozzarella.
Roll tightly into a cylinder, then coil into a spiral.
Brush with leftover egg and sprinkle with everything bagel seasoning. Bake 15 to 20 minutes until golden and crisp.
notes: From @thechefoutwest's rice paper collection. One spiral is a big meal (50 g protein); it splits well into two.

title: Big Mac Rice Paper Spirals
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F.
Mix the beef, mozzarella, onion and pickles with the paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper.
Whisk the eggs on a plate, dip each rice paper sheet for a few seconds, and overlap them on a lightly oiled surface.
Spoon the filling in a line, roll into a tight cylinder, and curl it into a spiral.
Brush with egg wash, sprinkle with sesame seeds, and bake 15 to 20 minutes until golden and crisp.
notes: From @thechefoutwest's rice paper collection. Special sauce left out (it usually has relish and sugar); dip in mustard, or mix Greek yogurt with diced dill pickle and mustard for a no-sugar version.

title: Crispy Chicken Rice Paper Bites

ingredients.note: finely chopped, plus more for garnish

steps: Mix the chicken, ginger, scallions, cilantro, garlic, tamari and salt.
Heat the air fryer to 380°F for 5 minutes.
Dip a rice paper sheet in a plate of water for about 5 seconds and lay it on a cutting board.
Shape a quarter of the filling into a flat 4-inch log in the middle, fold in the sides, and roll it up like an egg roll. Repeat with the other 3 sheets.
Cut each roll into 4 pieces, spray the basket and the bites, and air fry 12 minutes, shaking and spraying once or twice.
Stir the sauce ingredients together. Garnish the bites with scallions and sesame seeds and serve with the sauce.
notes: Instagram post: https://www.instagram.com/reel/De2QbUPhx8I/. Soy sauce swapped for gluten-free tamari and the honey dropped from the sauce. Site lists 39 cal and 3 g protein per bite; this is 8 bites per serving.

title: Chicken Parm Rice Paper Spiral
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F.
Whisk the egg in a shallow bowl and dip each rice paper sheet until just pliable.
Overlap the sheets on a lightly oiled surface to make one large sheet.
Add the chicken across the center, spoon over the marinara, and sprinkle with the cheese.
Roll tightly, coil into a compact spiral, and brush with leftover egg. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and Italian seasoning.
Bake 10 to 15 minutes until golden and crisp.
notes: From @thechefoutwest's rice paper collection. Use a marinara labeled no added sugar.

title: Rice Paper Croque Madame Pockets
steps: Heat the oven or air fryer to 425°F (convection if you have it).
Sprinkle about 1 tbsp everything bagel seasoning in a square a little bigger than a rice paper sheet.
Dip a rice paper sheet in the whisked eggs for 2 to 3 seconds and lay it on the seasoning. Dip a second sheet and lay it on top.
Spread 1 tbsp Dijon in the center, then add a slice of cheese and 3 slices of ham.
Fold the four corners in about 3/4 inch to make a square parcel.
Move to oiled parchment or the air fryer basket, crack an egg on top, and season with more everything bagel seasoning, salt and pepper.
Make the second pocket the same way. Bake 10 to 14 minutes until deeply golden and the whites are set.
notes: From @thechefoutwest's rice paper collection. Some hams are cured with sugar or honey; choose one with no added sugar if you want to be strict.

title: Cuban Sandwich Rice Paper Spiral
steps: Heat the oven or air fryer to 400°F (convection if you have it).
Dip each rice paper sheet in the whisked eggs for 2 to 3 seconds and overlap them to make one long sheet.
Layer the ham, then the roast pork, drizzle with mustard, and scatter the pickles and cheese edge to edge.
Roll tightly into a log and coil it into a spiral on greased parchment or in the air fryer basket.
Spray lightly with oil, brush with leftover egg, and sprinkle with smoked paprika and garlic powder.
Bake or air fry 15 to 20 minutes until deep golden and crisp.
Stir the dip ingredients together and serve on the side.
notes: From @thechefoutwest's rice paper collection. Barbecue seasoning swapped for smoked paprika and garlic powder (most BBQ rubs contain sugar). Site lists 820 cal and 60 g protein for the whole spiral; this is half. Choose ham with no added sugar if you want to be strict.

title: Bacon Egg & Cheese Rice Paper Dumplings

ingredients.item: Salt, pepper and olive oil spray

steps: Heat the oven to 375°F and grease a 6-cup deep muffin tin.
Whisk the 5 filling eggs with the mozzarella, bacon, salt and pepper.
Whisk the other 3 eggs in a wide shallow bowl.
Dip 2 rice paper sheets in the egg wash and press them into a muffin cup one after the other, edges hanging over. Repeat for all 6 cups.
Pour about 1/2 cup filling into each cup, stopping just below the top.
Fold the edges in and twist gently to seal. Spritz with oil.
Bake 22 to 28 minutes until golden and set. Cool 5 minutes before removing.
notes: From @thechefoutwest's rice paper collection. Reheat well for grab-and-go breakfasts. Most bacon has a little sugar in the cure; turkey bacon or sugar-free bacon avoids it.

title: Pepperoni Pizza Rice Paper Spiral
steps: Heat the oven or air fryer to 400°F.
Dip each rice paper sheet in the whisked egg until pliable and overlap them on a lightly oiled surface.
Layer the pepperoni, then the mozzarella. Spoon the sauce down the center and add the basil.
Roll tightly into a cylinder and coil into a compact spiral.
Brush with leftover egg, sprinkle with sesame seeds, and cook 15 to 20 minutes until golden and melty.
notes: From @thechefoutwest's rice paper collection. Use a pizza sauce or marinara labeled no added sugar, and skip his spicy-honey drizzle. Site lists 674 cal and 40 g protein for the whole spiral; this is half. Check the pepperoni label for gluten-free.

title: Rice Paper Spanakopita Spiral
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F.
Mix the chicken, spinach, mozzarella and feta, and season with salt and pepper.
Whisk the eggs on a shallow plate. Dip each rice paper sheet for a few seconds and lay it on a lightly oiled board.
Spoon filling in a line across each sheet and roll tightly into a cylinder.
Curl each roll into a spiral and tuck the end underneath.
Brush generously with egg wash, sprinkle with sesame seeds, and bake 15 to 20 minutes until golden and crisp. Serve with lemon.
notes: From @thechefoutwest's rice paper collection. Rotisserie chicken works well; check its label for gluten-free.

title: Roasted Brie with Pear, Prosciutto & Rosemary
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Stir together the honey, olive oil, chili oil, walnuts, garlic, thyme and a pinch of salt.
Set the brie in a baking dish with the pear slices, prosciutto and rosemary around it, and spoon the marinade over the top.
Put the baguette slices in a second dish.
Bake the brie 20 minutes. For the last 5 minutes switch to broil, with the brie on the lower rack and the bread on the top rack so it toasts.
Serve hot, scooping the brie onto the toasts.
notes: Translated from French. The caption gives ingredients and oven times; how the marinade and bread are arranged is an interpretation. Holiday recipe, kept as written. Gluten-free crackers or bread instead of baguette make it gluten-free. Nutrition is estimated with the bread.

title: Easy Roasted Garlic Soup

ingredients.item: Crispy bacon, shredded cheddar and fresh herbs

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Spread the potatoes, shallots and garlic heads on a lined baking sheet.
Drizzle generously with olive oil and season with salt, pepper, thyme and rosemary.
Roast 30 minutes, then cover with foil and roast 15 to 25 minutes more until the potatoes are tender and the garlic is soft and golden.
Move everything to a large pot and squeeze the garlic out of its skins.
Add the broth and cream and blend until smooth while still hot.
Season to taste, warm through, and top with olive oil, bacon, cheddar and herbs.
notes: Instagram post: https://www.instagram.com/reel/Df7g9DIOS7g/. Site lists only calories. The creator serves it with baguette; skip that or use gluten-free bread. A rich comfort soup.

title: Sausage & Hash Brown Balls
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F.
Mix everything until well combined (a stand mixer with the dough hook works best).
Roll into 1 1/2-inch balls and set on a rimmed baking sheet.
Bake 18 to 22 minutes, until browned.
notes: From Bree's recipe collection: always a huge hit at parties. Freeze them unbaked and add a few minutes when baking from frozen. Gluten-free Bisquick makes them gluten-free.

title: Skillet Roasted Carrots

ingredients.note: trimmed and cut on a bias (halved if large)

steps: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high. Add the carrots and season with salt and pepper.
Cook, stirring now and then, until browned in spots and tender-crisp, 6 to 8 minutes.
Add the vinegar and honey and cook about 1 minute, until syrupy and coating the carrots.
Sprinkle with thyme and serve right away.
notes: From Bree's recipe collection. A 10-minute side. The honey is added sugar; cut it to 1 tbsp or skip it to keep it lighter. Nutrition is estimated.

title: Slow-Cooker Green Beans
steps: Cut 6 slices of bacon into 1/2-inch pieces and cook in a large skillet over medium-high until crisp, about 8 minutes. Drain, keeping the drippings, and crumble.
Cook the onion in the drippings about 3 minutes, then stir in the green beans for 2 minutes.
Move to a 5-quart slow cooker and stir in the broth, salt, pepper, thyme and the 2 uncooked bacon slices.
Cover and cook on HIGH about 3 hours, until tender. Discard the whole bacon slices and thyme, and top with the crumbled bacon.
notes: From Bree's recipe collection. Frees up the oven on a big cooking day. Nutrition is estimated.

title: Smoked Mac & Cheese
steps: Heat a smoker or the oven to 350°F.
Boil the pasta in well-salted water until just short of al dente.
Meanwhile, melt the butter in a 12-inch cast-iron skillet over medium heat. Whisk in the flour for 1 to 2 minutes until golden.
Whisk in the milk for 1 to 2 minutes until it thickens. Stir in the Velveeta until nearly melted, then the cheddar and Gruyère until smooth. Take off the heat.
Drain the pasta and stir it straight into the sauce. Smooth the top.
Cover with the Muenster, then the Parmesan. Smoke or bake at least 30 minutes, until browned. Serve once it stops bubbling.
notes: From Bree's recipe collection. Hot sauce, mustard powder, paprika or a barbecue rub can go into the sauce if you like.

title: Smoked Turkey Legs

ingredients.note: 1/2 cup for less salty, 1 cup for saltier

ingredients.item: Hardwood lump charcoal and wood chips

steps: Bring all the brine ingredients to a boil, then cool completely.
Rinse the turkey legs, cover with the cooled brine, and refrigerate 24 hours. (Injecting brine into each leg speeds it up to 5 to 6 hours.)
Light a chimney of charcoal and heat 15 to 20 minutes until the coals are white-hot. Soak 1 to 2 handfuls of wood chips.
Pour the coals into the grill, scatter the wet chips around them, set the rack on, and lay the turkey legs on it. Close the lid.
Hold the grill at 300 to 325°F, adding a chimney of coals every 20 to 30 minutes and more wet chips for smoke. Turn the legs now and then.
Cook 3 1/2 to 4 hours, until the legs are deep, smoky brown.
notes: Disney-style turkey legs, from Bree's recipe collection. Needs a charcoal grill, chimney starter and wood chips; the original also gives an oven method.

title: Butternut Squash Gratin with Bacon & Gruyère

ingredients.note: weighed after peeling and seeding, cut into 3/4-inch cubes

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the squash with the oil, salt and pepper in a shallow baking dish and spread out.
Roast 25 to 35 minutes, stirring halfway, until golden and tender.
Meanwhile, cook the bacon until just crisp, drain, and chop.
Lower the oven to 400°F. Stir the cream, garlic and rosemary together.
Fold the cream mixture, half the Gruyère and half the bacon into the squash, and sprinkle the rest of the cheese on top.
Bake 10 to 15 minutes, adding the rest of the bacon for the last 3 minutes, until bubbling. Rest 5 to 10 minutes.
notes: Instagram post: https://www.instagram.com/reel/DgASgZhPjnz/. Serves 3 as written; double it for a holiday crowd. Nutrition is estimated.

title: Fresh Strawberry Bundt Cake
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F. Grease and flour a 10-inch Bundt pan.
Sift 2 1/4 cups of the flour with the baking soda and salt, and mix in the lemon zest.
Cream the butter and sugar 3 to 5 minutes until fluffy. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then 1 tbsp lemon juice.
Alternate beating in the flour mixture and the yogurt, mixing just until combined.
Toss the strawberries with the remaining 1/4 cup flour and fold them in.
Pour into the pan, put it in the oven, and lower the heat to 325°F. Bake about 60 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool 20 minutes in the pan, turn out, and cool completely. Whisk the remaining 2 tbsp lemon juice with the powdered sugar and drizzle over.
notes: From Bree's recipe collection. Thicker yogurt keeps the berries from sinking; either way it's good.

title: Sugared Cranberries & Rosemary
steps: Heat the water and sugar until the sugar dissolves. Let the syrup cool until just warm.
Stir in the cranberries (and rosemary sprigs, if using) to coat. Lift them out and let the excess drip off.
Roll them in sugar until coated and spread on a sheet of parchment.
Let dry about an hour at room temperature. Spear a few on a rosemary sprig to garnish each glass.
notes: A garnish, not a drink. Make it Wednesday. Use fresh cranberries; frozen don't hold the sugar. Sally's Baking Addiction has a version that soaks the berries overnight for a sparklier coat (https://sallysbakingaddiction.com/sugared-cranberries/).

title: Harvest Chicky Salad

ingredients.note: drained, or 1 1/2 cups shredded rotisserie chicken
canned, drained and diced (instead of celery; stays crunchy for days)
diced, optional (dill, not sweet or bread-and-butter)

steps: Drain the chicken well (or shred the rotisserie chicken) and break it into small pieces.
In a bowl, stir together the cottage cheese, Greek yogurt, mustard, garlic powder, onion powder, poppy seeds, salt and pepper.
Fold in the chicken, water chestnuts, pickles if using, red onion, chives, pecans and mozzarella if using.

Chill until ready to eat. Make a double batch on day one; it keeps 3 to 4 days in the fridge. If you'd rather use cucumber, seed it, pat it dry and stir it in just before eating so the salad doesn't get watery.
notes: Creator's numbers for the base, before mix-ins. Pecans add about 50 cal per tbsp; a mozzarella stick adds about 80 cal and 7 g protein. Mix-in amounts are suggestions (the creator didn't list them). Left out her apple, pomegranate and sweet potato sticks. Check canned or rotisserie chicken and mustard labels for gluten-free.

title: Sriracha Chicken Bowl

ingredients.note: use lightly, or swap in a plain hot sauce

steps: Warm the chicken if you like it hot.
Microwave the edamame and broccoli until hot.
Spoon the cottage cheese into a bowl and top with the chicken, edamame and broccoli.
Drizzle lightly with sriracha (or plain hot sauce) and finish with green onion and sesame seeds.
notes: Renamed from Honey Sriracha Bowl; honey dropped. Creator's numbers: about 350 cal, 53 g protein, 11 g fiber (carbs and fat not listed). Sriracha has a little sugar, so use it lightly or use a plain hot sauce. About 5 minutes once the chicken is cooked. Check the sriracha label for gluten-free.

title: Sweet Potato Brownies

ingredients.item: cacao nibs or chopped 100% dark chocolate

steps: Heat the oven to 350°F and line a small baking dish with parchment.
Mash the sweet potato and banana together, then mix in the eggs and cocoa.
Fold in half the cacao nibs, spread in the dish, and sprinkle the rest on top.
Bake about 20 minutes. Cool slightly before cutting into 9 squares.
notes: Chocolate chips swapped for cacao nibs or 100% dark chocolate to keep it free of added sugar; the banana does the sweetening. A treat, not a protein snack. Nutrition is estimated.

title: Sweet Potato Omelette
steps: Grease a nonstick skillet and set it over medium heat.
Grate the sweet potato straight into the pan in a thin, even layer and cook about 5 minutes, until tender with crisp edges.
Crack the eggs over the top, spread them out, and season with salt and pepper.
Add the cheese and fillings, cover, and cook until the eggs are set.
Roll it up and serve.
notes: Recipe by @eatswithjamie. The creator used 1 egg and no amounts; try 2 eggs for more protein. Nutrition is estimated with 2 eggs and cheddar.

title: Sweet Potato Skins with Whipped Feta & Avocado

ingredients.note: plus a drizzle for the feta

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Brush the sweet potato halves with olive oil, season with salt and pepper, and bake until tender, about 35 to 40 minutes.
Scoop out some of the centers to make sturdy skins (save the scooped sweet potato for another meal) and bake 10 more minutes until crisp.
Blend the feta, Greek yogurt, a drizzle of olive oil, garlic and lemon juice until light and creamy.
Spread the whipped feta in the warm skins, top with avocado, cilantro and a pinch of chili flakes if you like.
notes: Chili honey dropped. The creator didn't give amounts, so these are estimates. Lower in protein; pair with chicken or eggs to make it a full meal. Nutrition is estimated.

title: Garlic Butter Sweet Potato Stacks
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F. Peel the sweet potatoes, trim them to fit a muffin tin, and slice into thin 1/8-inch rounds.
Brush the muffin cups with melted butter. Mix the rest of the butter with the rosemary, garlic, salt and pepper, and toss the slices in it.
Toss the coated slices with parmesan and stack them into the 12 cups. Brush any leftover butter and parmesan over the tops.
Cover with foil and bake 35 minutes. Uncover, raise the heat to 400°F, and bake 15 more until soft in the center and lightly charred.
Scoop out and brush with the butter left in the tin.
notes: Instagram post: https://www.instagram.com/reel/Dfeow-VIaIQ/. A side dish, low in protein; serve with chicken or fish. Site lists 122 cal per stack; this is 2 stacks per serving.

title: Thanksgiving Butternut Squash & Chickpea Salad

ingredients.note: 2 for the squash, 1 for the chickpeas

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.

Toss the squash with 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 1/2 tbsp maple syrup, 1/2 tsp each smoked paprika, garlic powder and salt, and 1/4 tsp pepper. Toss the chickpeas with 1 tbsp olive oil, 1/2 tsp smoked paprika and 1/4 tsp each garlic powder and salt.
Roast both on sheet pans 25 to 30 minutes until golden. Cool slightly.
Whisk the dressing: browned butter, olive oil, lemon juice, maple syrup, mustard, garlic, 1/2 tsp salt and 1/4 tsp pepper.
Combine the squash, chickpeas, apple, onion, pomegranate, walnuts, cheddar and parsley, pour over the dressing, and toss.
notes: Recipe by @gabriela_polacek. Holiday recipe, kept as written (it has maple syrup). Nutrition is estimated.

title: Roasted Tomato & Chickpea Pasta
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F.
Toss the onion, garlic, oregano, pepper flakes, chickpeas and tomatoes in a baking dish. Drizzle with olive oil, add the stock, and season with salt and pepper.
Roast 50 to 60 minutes, stirring halfway.
Meanwhile, cook the spaghetti until al dente and drain.
Toss the pasta into the roasted vegetables with the spinach so it wilts.
Finish with more olive oil, season to taste, and top with basil and Parmesan if you like.
notes: From Bree's recipe collection. The original lists 350 cal per serving, which looks low for 12 oz pasta and 1/4 cup oil across 4 servings; this estimate is higher. Gluten-free spaghetti makes it gluten-free.

title: Baked Parmesan Zucchini Rounds
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F and line a baking tray with parchment.
Pat the zucchini slices very dry with paper towels.
Toss with olive oil, garlic powder, salt and pepper.
Lay the rounds in a single layer and press a little parmesan onto each.
Roast 15 to 20 minutes until tender and golden; broil 1 minute for a deeper crust, watching closely.
Garnish with parsley and serve hot.
notes: Left out the optional panko (wheat) to keep it gluten-free. Creator lists 85 cal per serving; the estimate here is a little higher.
